sections.Profile:
The "Hootenanny" pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in November 1963, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a music and dancing theme. Designed by Ted Zale, it features two flippers, three pop bumpers, one mushroom bumper, three slingshots, and three standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Singing, Dancing, Original Theme, Music, Single level playfield
